fact: An ENSEA study presented in July 2024 says the productive social safety nets project delivered 94% of its digital payments on time, calling it the first digital payment system of its kind for a national programme in West Africa, with mobile financial services cutting transaction fees.
system: digital payment system of the productive social safety nets project

fact: The World Bank's May 2025 status report on the productive social safety nets project says its beneficiary figures come from the programme's MIS, and that until November 2024 household counts came from the cash-transfer programme's MIS database.
